summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K reporting repurchases of 98,648 of its own shares from July 13-17, 2026 under a program announced June 9, 2026, executed via a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary on Euronext and other venues. The average price paid was €26.00 per share, with total consideration ~€2.56M. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. As of July 17, 2026, the company holds 511,049 treasury shares. The filing is a routine buyback update; there are no structural changes or risk-arb angles. The repurchase is consistent with a capital return program.
